title: task_retry documentation doesn't mention possible null and ignored args

# Description
<!--
Please describe what's missing or incorrect about our documentation.
Include links and/or screenshots which will aid us to resolve the issue.
-->
https://docs.celeryq.dev/en/latest/userguide/signals.html#task-retry `task_retry` docs are a bit misleading indicating that in all cases `einfo` will be given as well as the `reason` arg.

But if we see https://github.com/celery/celery/blob/6dcecbe52da8717c015203f5e0f6b8d684b6ccc9/celery/worker/request.py#L447 here we have `send_retry` (an alias to `task_retry`)  not passing over `einfo` and `reason`. 

This broke our custom signal handling since it expected them to be always be present. This issue only became apparent after https://github.com/celery/celery/commit/53dc515c77efd1fb19aad599b05ad96d886e5327


# Suggestions
<!-- Please provide us suggestions for how to fix the documentation -->
Indicate in documentation which args can be relied on
